environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed with custom OCI runtime wrapper. The execution environment uses a Firecracker microVM configuration with a supplementary seccomp filter profile applied at the jailer level (--seccomp-filter flag). The BPF filter program denies syscalls: connect(2) (nr 42), socket(2) (nr 41), sendto(2) (nr 44), sendmsg(2) (nr 46) with SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO(EPERM). Note: the profile permits read/write/open/stat/mmap and other filesystem syscalls needed for normal Lambda operation. The filter is loaded before the Lambda runtime init process spawns. Additionally, the Lambda is deployed in a VPC with a security group (sg-0a8f3e) that has ZERO egress rules (all outbound traffic denied) and no NAT gateway or VPC endpoint for external connectivity. DNS resolution within the VPC returns NXDOMAIN for external hostnames due to absence of Route53 resolver outbound endpoint.

config.vpc: vpc-isolated-0x3f (no NAT, no IGW attachment to Lambda subnets)
config.seccomp_profile: custom BPF filter: DENY connect(2)/socket(2)/sendto(2)/sendmsg(2) → EPERM
config.dns: VPC DHCP option set with AmazonProvidedDNS only, no outbound resolver endpoint
